title: CLO Skills Classroom - How to Link CLO-SET & CONNECT in CLO
description: CLO technical experts teach you how to directly link CONNECT and CLO-SET within CLO to achieve a seamless workflow.
transcript:
How to connect with CloseSight  
How to connect with CloseSight  
First, you need to log in to your CloseSight account in CloseSight.  
Open the CloseSight app and click on CloseTool庫 in the upper right corner.  
Or press the Y button to open CloseTool庫.  
In the option tab at the top of the tool庫, switch to CloseSight.  
Click on Log in and navigate to the CloseSight Login page.  
Enter your CloseSight account and password.  
Click on Log in and close the page.  
Return to the CloseTool app and check the CloseSight assets in the tool庫 window.  
The way the tool庫 operates is similar to the webpage.  
In the left-hand panel, you can switch between different groups.  
In the layer bar, select the corresponding workspace.  
Double-click to open the selected file.  
After opening, we can close the tool庫.  
Click on the X or press the shortcut key to close it.  
In CloseTool,  
we can change the design of the clothing.  
After the design is complete, open the tool庫.  
Find the appropriate fabric from the CloseSight company resource library.  
Double-click to download.  
Apply the fabric to the clothing.  
Open the tool庫.  
In the option tab at the top of the tool庫, select Connect.  
In the left-hand selection bar, select virtual model.  
Here we can change the model’s shoes, hairstyle, etc.  
Select the type of hair.  
Select gender and age as female.  
The compatibility is clone female.  
The price is free.  
After finding the appropriate material, double-click to change the model’s hairstyle.  
Now switch the type to shoes.  
Other settings remain unchanged.  
Double-click to change the model’s shoes.  
Switch the type to posture.  
Other settings remain unchanged.  
Double-click to change the model’s posture.  
In the left-hand selection bar, switch from virtual model to scene.  
The price is still free.  
Double-click to add the scene.  
After completion, close the tool庫.  
When all the files are completed,  
upload this file to CloseSight.  
In the main menu, select CloseSight.  
You can choose to upload new content or a new version.  
On the CloseSight webpage, you can choose different groups.  
Choose an hour or two.  
Select Workroom, and click Next to finish uploading.  
If you have other content to watch,  
choose YouTube, YouTube Live, or PodCast.  
If you have other content to watch,  
choose YouTube Live, or PodCast.  
Click Next and wait until the end.  
Click Next to see the uploaded video.

chunks.content: ## Connecting and Logging into CloseSight via CloseTool This section explains how to access CloseSight resources through the CloseTool application, focusing on the login process and navigating the CloseSight asset library. 1. Open the CloseTool application. 2. Click on **CloseTool庫** in the upper right corner or press the **Y** key to open it. 3. In the **option tab** at the top of the CloseTool庫 window, switch to the **CloseSight** tab. 4. Click **Log in** to navigate to the CloseSight login page. 5. Enter your CloseSight account credentials and click **Log in**. 6. Close the login page to return to CloseTool. 7. Confirm that CloseSight assets are visible in the CloseTool庫 window. The CloseTool庫 interface functions similarly to the CloseSight website, with a left-hand panel for switching between groups and a layer bar for selecting workspaces. Double-click any file to open it. You can close the tool庫 by clicking the X or using the shortcut key. --- ## Using CloseSight Fabrics and Applying Them in CloseTool This section covers selecting fabric materials from CloseSight's resource library and applying them to clothing designs within CloseTool. 1. After completing your clothing design in CloseTool, open the CloseTool庫 again. 2. Navigate the CloseSight company fabric resource library to find the desired fabric. 3. Double-click the fabric to download it. 4. Apply the downloaded fabric to your clothing design. --- ## Customizing Virtual Models in CloseTool Using Connect This section details how to customize virtual models by changing features such as hairstyle, shoes, and posture through the Connect tab within CloseTool. 1. Open CloseTool庫 and switch to the **Connect** tab at the top. 2. In the left-hand selection bar, select **Virtual Model**. 3. Customize the model’s attributes: - **Hairstyle:** Select hair type, gender (female), and age. The compatible model is “clone female” and this feature is free. - Double-click the preferred hairstyle to apply it. 4. Change the model’s **Shoes** by switching the type to shoes and double-clicking the choice. 5. Modify **Posture** by switching the type to posture and double-clicking the preferred option. --- ## Adding Scenes to Virtual Models in CloseTool This section explains how to add background scenes to virtual models using the Connect tab in CloseTool. 1. In the left-hand selection bar of the Connect tab, switch from **Virtual Model** to **Scene**. 2. Scene options are free. 3. Double-click the desired scene to add it to the model. 4. After customization, close the CloseTool庫. --- ## Uploading Completed Files to CloseSight This section describes the process of uploading finished design files from CloseTool back to CloseSight. 1. When all files are finalized, in CloseTool’s main menu, select **CloseSight**. 2. Choose to upload either new content or a new version of existing content. 3. On the CloseSight webpage, select the appropriate group and workroom. 4. Follow prompts by clicking **Next** to complete the upload process. --- ## Additional Content Management in CloseSight This brief section notes options for managing other types of multimedia content within CloseSight.

chunks.content: --- ## Uploading Completed Files to CloseSight This section describes the process of uploading finished design files from CloseTool back to CloseSight. 1. When all files are finalized, in CloseTool’s main menu, select **CloseSight**. 2. Choose to upload either new content or a new version of existing content. 3. On the CloseSight webpage, select the appropriate group and workroom. 4. Follow prompts by clicking **Next** to complete the upload process. --- ## Additional Content Management in CloseSight This brief section notes options for managing other types of multimedia content within CloseSight. - You can select and upload additional content types such as **YouTube**, **YouTube Live**, or **PodCast**. - Follow the prompts by clicking **Next** and wait for the upload to finish. - After completion, click **Next** again to view the uploaded video or content. --- # Summary This document outlined the end-to-end workflow for integrating CloseSight resources within CloseTool, including logging in, accessing and applying fabrics, customizing virtual models and scenes, and uploading final files back to CloseSight. It also highlighted multimedia content management options available through CloseSight’s platform.
